caption: Cara Svetlana, grazie a te per il tuo impegno e coraggio. Puoi sempre contare su di me in questa comune battaglia per la libertà. Un caro saluto anche a Sergei e ai tuoi figli.
text: Dear Antonio, from the bottom of my heart, thank you. After five years, I've finally been able to see my husband, Sergei, again. And our children were finally able to reunite with their father. That reunion was possible thanks to your continued support and moral courage. You have stood by us, by Belarus, and by the course of freedom. But we must keep going until all political prisoners are released and Belarus is truly free. Sergei and I would love to see you soon, in person. So thank you properly. Thank you.
